equipment.description: Known. Exactly one per ship; losing it destroys the ship.
Known. Cheap basic protection.
Known. Dense durable structure; heavier than loose plate.
Known. Flexible small-target weapon.
Known. Basic movement.
Known. Renewable protection with a recharge interruption.
Known. Bounded adjacency operating-rate bonus.
Known; ranks in section 7. RP and automatic weak-point analysis: +5% damage against one visible alien target, refresh every 8 s, strongest source only. Scan is a general Foundation ability.
Applied Energy. Reliable ranged beam.
Applied Energy. Better damage density; concentrated vulnerability.
Field Engineering. Heavy-hull propulsion.
Field Engineering. Repairs two adjacent components using a finite reserve.
Guided Munitions. Intercepts missiles/strike craft; weak hull damage.
Guided Munitions. Long-range interceptable burst.
Optics I. Improves two adjacent beam weapons' damage/range; longer windup.
Optics II. Charged shot through exposed components.
Optics III, capstone. Targeted piercing beam through aligned ships and organs.
Disruption I. Shield pressure; targeted interruption ability.
Disruption II. Slows target movement/turning; targeted control field.
Disruption III, capstone. Pulls enemies together, then detonates.
Bastion I. Reduces projectile hull damage to two adjacent components.
Bastion II. Transfers a bounded amount of host shield to a nearby ally.
Bastion III, capstone. Large finite protective field for nearby allies.
Renewal I. Interceptable drones repair allies using a finite reserve.
Renewal II. Reconstructs one destroyed non-command component on its host, once per battle.
Renewal III, capstone. Emergency fleet repair and bounded reconstruction.
Siege I. Accelerates two adjacent projectile weapons; local destruction blast.
Siege II. Slow, long-range armor penetration.
Siege III, capstone. Devastating targeted penetrating volley; host temporarily anchors.
Carrier I. Interceptor squadron; finite replacement craft.
Carrier II. Heavy strike craft, vulnerable to point defense.
Carrier III, capstone. Coordinated mixed strike wave with a finite sortie reserve.
Command I. Marks priority targets and coordinates nearby allies.
Command II. Synchronizes up to three adjacent weapons into a vulnerability-window burst.
Command III, capstone. Major temporary coordinated fleet offensive.
Covert I. Breaks a bounded number of missile locks and weakens enemy target coordination.
Covert II. Short targeted reposition, with valid-space and range checks.
Covert III, capstone. Conceals nearby allies briefly and creates finite decoys.
Civil Hospitality. Four places, luxury 1.
Civil Hospitality. +1 luxury to two adjacent accommodations; exterior edge required.
Luxury Habitation. Four places, luxury 2; greater durability.
Grand Hospitality; capstone. +1 host luxury, Sanctuary ability.
Known. Ten trade-goods capacity, upgraded to 15 by Freight Engineering.
Material Handling. Doubles host pickup radius; Tether ability.
Selective Recovery. +15 percentage points construction-material recovery; material preference.
Industrial Integration; capstone. +25 recovery points; Field Patch ability.
Analysis Methods. +25% to one adjacent lab; two-step map intelligence.
Quantum Observation; capstone. Further +25% to one adjacent lab; Forecast ability.
Sensor Networks. Host sight 260 → 400; radar 480 → 720. Strongest source only.
Sensor Networks. +120 radar range for nearby allies within 240; no added visual detail.
Cloaking Theory. Automatic cloak after 8 s without attacking/taking damage; Scan and proximity counter it.
Basic Extraction. Ranged rock destruction; 75% extraction. Regular slots only.
Basic Extraction. Close-range 100% extraction; must approach hazardous rocks. Regular slots only.
Deep Extraction. +15 recovery points for asteroid ore; strongest source only. Regular slots only.
Deep Extraction. Targeted rock-cluster fracture; low ship damage. Regular slots only.
Planetary Fracture; capstone. Large controlled fracture, 100% extraction, limited rate. Regular slots only.

abilities.description: Place radius-180 circle within 450 of a friendly Command Center; reveal area and cloaked entities for 6 s. Spectroscopy adds persistent ore identification. No damage bonus.
Visible enemy within 500; +20% allied damage for 5 s, strongest mark only. Lab analysis does not stack with it.
Visible target within 300; interrupt charge and suppress shield regeneration for 4 s. Boss interruption follows boss limits.
Visible radius-100 area within 350; slow movement/turning 35% for 5 s; no boss immobilization.
Visible rock, pickup, or nonboss enemy within 300; slow and pull toward a chosen safe point for 3 s; preserve rock collision danger.
Move host up to 120 into explored, currently visible free space; cannot cross arena boundary or overlap entities.
Break up to six enemy missile locks within 160; no invulnerability.
Allies within 180 gain 35% damage reduction for 6 s; applies normally to occupied cabins.
Repair nearby surviving parts for at most 15% of host aggregate max HP per cast; finite battle reserve 30%; no passengers/cargo resurrection.
Show enemy targeting intent for 6 s; allies within 200 gain 25% damage reduction for 4 s. Does not reveal unseen ships.
Visible radius-100 rock cluster within 350; deal 60 rock damage, only 15 against ships.
Visible radius-220 area within 450; deal 200 rock damage, only 50 against ships. Fragments still exist; finite ore budget remains.
